Xènia + Abdoul

A story that begins in Morocco.

Two people, two paths and a life shared between Catalonia and the Sahara.

The paths cross

Since 2009, building journeys together.

Xènia and Abdoul began travelling and working in Morocco in 2009. Over the years they built a network of accommodation and partners and coordinated journeys for travellers, groups and tourism professionals.

Today that experience takes shape in Sahara Bless Travel: a close, personal way of organising journeys, with people and local knowledge at the centre.

Abdoul · Erg Chigaga

The Sahara is part of his life.

Abdoul was born in the Sahara and lived there until he was seven. Now he owns his own camp in Erg Chigaga. His bond with the desert runs through the routes and experiences the team designs in this region.

With his own fleet of 4×4 vehicles and a long track record working with hotels in Morocco, knowledge of the terrain also translates into operational capacity.
